leftColumn.title: Upside vs Downside Volume
leftColumn.subtitle: Capital flow conviction
bullets: Upside Volume = Volume in advancing stocks
Downside Volume = Volume in declining stocks
9-to-1 Up Volume days signal genuine breakaway breadth thrusts

rightColumn.title: Arms Index (TRIN)
rightColumn.subtitle: Volume efficiency ratio
bullets: TRIN = (Advances / Declines) ÷ (Up Volume / Down Volume)
TRIN = 1.0 indicates neutral balanced flow
TRIN < 1.0 means heavier volume entering advancing stocks (Bullish)

beats.en_narration: Richard Arms combined advances and volume to develop the Arms Index (TRIN).

beats.hindi_tts: Remember: TRIN is inverted. Below 1.0 is bullish, and above 2.0 indicates panic selling.
beats.en_subtitle: Remember: TRIN is inverted. Below 1.0 is bullish, and above 2.0 indicates panic selling.

leftColumn.title: TRIN < 0.70
leftColumn.subtitle: Bullish buying pressure
bullets: Disproportionate volume pouring into advancers
Strong institutional participation
But extreme low (<0.50) can mean short-term overbought exhaustion

rightColumn.title: TRIN > 1.50 - 2.00
rightColumn.subtitle: Bearish panic dump
bullets: Heavy institutional dump on declining stocks
Extreme spike (>2.50) marks capitulation washouts
Often sets up major contrarian reversal bottoms
